name: Dingli Cliffs
description: The highest point on the islands at 253m, straight down into the sea, with the terraced fields running right up to the edge. Filfla island sits offshore — it was used as an RAF bombing target until 1971 and you still can't land on it.
getting: Bus 52 from Rabat, or twenty minutes by car from Mdina. Walk the cliff path south past the chapel for the better angles.
